about.title: About Operion
about.subtitle: Building logistics software that transport companies actually need.
about.values.realNeedsDesc: We build features that solve actual problems transport companies face every day.
about.values.reliabilityDesc: Transport operations depend on reliable tools. We prioritize stability and correctness.
about.values.innovationDesc: We use proven technologies to solve logistics challenges, not chase trends.
about.values.openDesc: Our roadmap is public. We build in the open and welcome feedback from the logistics community.
about.values.localDesc: Your data stays on your machine. No forced cloud storage. You control your information.
about.values.simpleDesc: Powerful tools that are intuitive to use. No bloated interfaces or unnecessary complexity.
about.techStack.desc: Operion is built with Python and PySide6 for the desktop application, FastAPI for the backend API, React and TypeScript for the web portal, and SQLite as the local database.

about.tech.python.desc: Desktop application built with Python and Qt for native Windows performance.
about.tech.sqlite.title: SQLite
about.tech.sqlite.desc: Fast, reliable local database — your data stays on your machine.
about.tech.graphhopper.title: GraphHopper
about.tech.graphhopper.desc: Industry-standard routing engine for precise distance and ETA calculations.
about.tech.architecture.title: FastAPI Backend
about.tech.architecture.desc: Modern async Python API powering the web portal and integrations.
about.philosophy.quality.title: Quality Over Speed
about.philosophy.quality.desc: We ship features when they are ready, not when they are rushed. Every release is tested for reliability.
about.philosophy.iterative.title: Iterative Development
about.philosophy.iterative.desc: We release early, gather feedback, and improve continuously. The product evolves with real user input.
about.philosophy.architecture.title: Clean Architecture
about.philosophy.architecture.desc: Separation of concerns, modular design, and maintainable code. Built for the long term.

about.story.p1: Operion started with a simple observation: transport companies were spending too much time on manual calculations and paperwork. Spreadsheets and disconnected tools were the industry standard — and they were holding businesses back.
about.story.p2: A team in Romania set out to build a better way. The goal was a logistics platform that combines route planning, fleet management, dispatch, and profit calculation into a single, intuitive application. No bloated enterprise suites. No hidden costs. Just powerful tools that work.
about.mission.text: To make logistics software that transport companies actually need — powerful, reliable, and accessible. We are building tools that reduce operational complexity, save time, and improve profitability for fleets of all sizes.
about.values.subtitle: The principles that guide how we build.
about.team.text: Operion is built by a small, focused team based in Romania. We are engineers and logistics enthusiasts who believe that great software comes from understanding real operational problems — not just chasing trends. We work remotely, ship frequently, and welcome feedback from the logistics community.

security.title: Security at Operion
security.metaDesc: Operion's security approach: encryption, access control, secure development, and our path to compliance.
security.heroDesc: Security is not a feature â€” it is the foundation of everything we build. We are committed to transparent security practices from day one.
security.practicesDesc: How we approach security while building Operion.
security.encryptionDesc: All network communication is secured using modern TLS protocols. We follow cryptographic best practices and keep dependencies up to date.
security.accessControlDesc: Building role-based access control with the principle of least privilege. Authentication and authorization are core architectural concerns from day one.
security.secureDevDesc: Code reviews, dependency scanning, and security considerations are part of every change. We ship features only after ensuring they meet our security bar.
security.futureComplianceDesc: We are building toward formal compliance certifications (SOC 2, GDPR alignment) before general availability. Security is not bolted on â€” it is built in.
security.disclosureDesc: We believe in working together with the security community to keep Operion safe.
security.disclosureCalloutText: If you discover a security vulnerability in any Operion product or service, please report it to us privately. We ask that you give us reasonable time to investigate and address the issue before disclosing it publicly.
security.timeline1.label: Acknowledgment
security.timeline2.label: Initial Assessment
security.timeline3.label: Resolution Timeline
security.faqDesc: Common questions about how we handle and protect your data.
security.faq1.a: Operion follows a local-first architecture. During development, your data stays on your machine. We do not collect or store sensitive operational data on external servers.
security.faq2.q: What security measures are in place during development?
security.faq2.a: We follow secure coding practices, conduct code reviews for every change, and use dependency scanning to catch known vulnerabilities. Formal security auditing will follow before launch.
security.faq3.q: Is Operion SOC 2 or GDPR compliant?
security.faq3.a: Not yet. Compliance certifications will be pursued as the product matures toward production launch. We are committed to meeting enterprise security standards before general availability.
security.faq4.q: How is data protected during development?
security.faq4.a: All network communication uses modern TLS encryption. We follow the principle of least privilege for access and keep our dependencies updated to address security patches promptly.
security.faq5.a: Yes. Operion is being built openly. Source code is available for review, and we welcome community input on security-related decisions.
security.faq6.q: How do I report a security issue?
security.faq6.a: Please report vulnerabilities privately to security@operion.com. We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work with you to address the issue promptly.
security.bugBountyDesc: Recognizing the researchers who help us stay secure.
security.bugBountyText: We are preparing a formal bug bounty program with competitive rewards for valid security findings. In the meantime, responsible disclosures are always welcome and acknowledged.
security.ctaTitle: Ready to see Operion in action?
security.ctaDesc: Have questions about our security approach? We are happy to discuss them.

trustCenter.metaDesc: Operion Trust Center: transparency, security, and privacy information for an operations platform in development.
trustCenter.heroDesc: Transparency and trust are core to Operion. We share what we build, how we build it, and what you can expect as the product evolves.
trustCenter.stat3.label: Public development
trustCenter.infrastructure1.title: Local-First Architecture
trustCenter.infrastructure1.desc: Built on a local-first model where your data resides on your own infrastructure. No mandatory cloud dependency for core operations.
trustCenter.infrastructure2.title: Network Security
trustCenter.infrastructure2.desc: Secure communication channels using modern TLS protocols. Network boundaries are designed with isolation principles from day one.
trustCenter.infrastructure3.title: Development Monitoring
trustCenter.infrastructure3.desc: Comprehensive logging and telemetry during development to identify and resolve issues before production deployment.
trustCenter.infrastructure4.title: Data Portability
trustCenter.infrastructure4.desc: Your data is never locked in. Export and import capabilities ensure you maintain full control and ownership at all times.
trustCenter.infrastructureStatusDesc: Operion is currently in active development. Infrastructure architecture and availability details will be published as the product nears launch.
trustCenter.security1.title: Encryption in Transit
trustCenter.security1.desc: All network communication is secured using modern TLS protocols. We follow cryptographic best practices to protect data as it moves between systems.
trustCenter.security2.title: Authentication
trustCenter.security2.desc: We are building authentication with security best practices, including support for modern standards like OAuth 2.0 and secure session management.
trustCenter.security3.title: Secure by Design
trustCenter.security3.desc: Security principles guide every architectural decision. We follow the principle of least privilege and conduct regular code reviews to catch issues early.
trustCenter.security4.title: Transparent Development
trustCenter.security4.desc: Our development process is open and auditable. Security-related decisions and architecture are documented and available for community review.
trustCenter.privacy1.title: Data Collection Philosophy
trustCenter.privacy1.desc: We follow a local-first approach: your data stays on your machine. No telemetry, no advertising tracking, and no data sales. You remain in control at all times.
trustCenter.privacy2.title: Privacy by Design
trustCenter.privacy2.desc: Privacy principles guide every architectural decision. We minimize data collection and process information only for clearly stated purposes.
trustCenter.privacy3.title: Data Retention
trustCenter.privacy3.desc: Retention policies will be clearly defined and configurable at launch. We are committed to never retaining data longer than necessary for the stated purpose.
trustCenter.privacy4.title: Data Deletion
trustCenter.privacy4.desc: Account deletion and data removal capabilities are being built as core features. You will have full control to delete your data at any time.
trustCenter.reliability.title: Reliability
trustCenter.reliability.desc: Operion is in active development. Uptime metrics, backup policies, and disaster recovery procedures will be published as the product nears launch. No incidents to report â€” the service is not yet publicly deployed.
trustCenter.faqDesc: Common questions about how we handle and protect your data.
trustCenter.faq1.a: Operion is in active development and not yet publicly deployed. We are building the product openly and will share production timelines as they solidify.
trustCenter.faq2.q: How is my data handled during development?
trustCenter.faq2.a: Our architecture follows a local-first approach where your data stays on your machine. We do not collect or store sensitive operational data on external servers during the development phase.
trustCenter.faq3.q: Can I see the source code?
trustCenter.faq3.a: Operion is being built with openness in mind. Source code and development progress are publicly available. We believe transparency builds trust.
trustCenter.faq4.q: What security practices are followed during development?
trustCenter.faq4.a: Security is a priority from day one. We follow secure coding practices, conduct code reviews, and are building toward formal security auditing as the product matures.
trustCenter.faq5.q: When will compliance certifications be available?
trustCenter.faq5.a: Compliance certifications such as SOC 2 and GDPR alignment will be pursued as the product matures toward production launch. We are committed to meeting enterprise security standards before general availability.
trustCenter.ctaDesc: Our security team is happy to answer questions, share documentation, or arrange a security review.
